selection.rule: All ten consecutive fiscal-quarter results from 2022Q1 through 2024Q2 in chronological order; no return, crossover or blocking criterion; no replacement of excluded events.
selection.reason: Reuse the existing AMD common-stock integration and inspect the ten immediately preceding fiscal quarters before the preserved 2024Q3 engineering example.
selection.correlation: One issuer and semiconductor exposure; correlated dates and regimes. Ten events are a budget, not statistical power.

window.calendar: Actual XNAS regular-session calendar with holidays and early closes independently evidenced; no weekday approximation.
window.release_on_non_session_date: RETAIN_AS_EXCLUDED_DATE_UNSUPPORTED; do not shift into a convenient session.

common.cost_stress_rule: Multiply both fee and slippage by two; no parameter search or changed signal rule.
common.benchmark: Single-entry buy-and-hold, same 26 score sessions, USD10000, 25% initial allocation and same costs; canonical benchmark ceiling max_position_pct=1/min_cash_pct=0, no stops/targets. The allocation target remains 25%, not 100%.
common.capital_reset: Each event is a separate USD10000 diagnostic; do not compound/sum overlapping window returns into a portfolio.

corporate_actions.policy: Require bounded stable identity and complete no-holder-cash-or-share-action evidence for all 38 sessions; otherwise retain EXCLUDED_UNSUPPORTED_ACTION or BLOCKED_ACTION_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN.
corporate_actions.bias: Action-free windows restrict the research population; all exclusions remain in the denominator and are reported, with no replacement.

proposed_future_source_read_scope.calls: 10 K60M requests (max266 rows/window), 10 K_DAY crosschecks (max38/window), 1 bounded corporate-action query, 1 security metadata query; no pagination retry or automatic symbol fallback.
proposed_future_source_read_scope.stop_conditions: Stop on budget, permission, unavailable data, unexpected paging or identity change; retain the exact failed/excluded event. Separate calendar/issuer evidence is required before data admission.

required_outputs: Planned schedule coverage at event open
A original BUY and B path original BUY separately
B expected-date BUY, known-schedule intervenable BUY, actual blocks, declared-lag misses
Existing modelled position across sourced release clock, or explicit UNKNOWN
Normal and stress A/B plus aligned buy-and-hold
Same-input replay, disabled-rule equivalence and future-version noninterference
C_D: NOT_RUN_PENDING_HUMAN_FISCAL_QUARTER_UNITS_MULTIPLIER_CURRENCY_ACCOUNTING_BASIS_APPROVAL; no consensus snapshot, no surprise field
original_2024Q3: Separate preserved engineering example; no re-selection, no changed 5/10 signals, no overwriting old reports or baseline dates. New aligned/cost diagnostics are additional experiments.
